rationale: F7 (master review 2026-09-30), the NEGATIVE half, and the reason a one-sided fixture would not have been a gate. `hasTypeInference` must be a per-file statement about what the pipeline did: this SFC has a plain `<script>` block, which is dispatched to the JAVAScript analyzer, so no type inference was available and the honest answer is `false`. Without this fixture a mutant that flipped the hardcoded constant to `true` unconditionally would pass vue/ts-type-inference and be CAUGHT by nothing — the same lesson the M49 T6 gap records for a claim with no negative half.
